That's all a bit over my head, honestly — React, Fastify, SQLite and so on don't mean much to me, and I'll trust your judgment on how it's built under the hood.

What I care about is that everything we agreed on is still there: pasting a link and having the details filled in, no duplicates, Read Later staying separate from favorites, the archive behavior we just confirmed, the smarter search with tags and phrases, acting on a whole batch at once, formatted notes, and the saved views. It sounds like the plan keeps all of that intact.

Go ahead — the plan is approved. Please move on to the next step.
